Question about my documents: repeated heating failure

Good afternoon

As I understand it: The living room is around 16 degrees in the morning; After a reset the heating works briefly and stops again; I have called three times; this is how I recorded it.

Regarding “repeated heating failure”, my notes show: the calibrated temperature remains unresolved; for the request “lasting repair and review of possible remedies”: I have included everything currently available to me; on “repeated heating failure”, I want clarity before acting; also unresolved: the service cause; I cannot currently support anything further.

I am specifically asking for: lasting repair and review of possible remedies; in particular, I need clarity about the service cause and whether the records support an initial assessment.

My first note about it is dated 01 February 2025.

Thank you for clarifying; Before acting I need to know the calibrated temperature; I want to base what I do on that.

Best regards
